pass_semantics: all six requested mechanism-off interventions are executable and traceable in their native matched lanes; negative results and claim downgrades are preserved without a cross-lane score

causal_contract.same_trace_rule: active and off consume the same stored observation/target unit within each lane; metrics never cross lanes
causal_contract.positive_benefit_convention: active-minus-off for higher-is-better metrics and off-minus-active for lower-is-better metrics

nonmixing_contract.reason: controller lifetime, parameter MSE, regime NLL, event cost, and syndrome logical-class error are different estimands

history.scope: matched finite-cutoff two-level ten-cycle controller only

cnn_residual.scope: held-out residual-parameter prediction only; not LER or control gain

regime_state.scope: synthetic regime estimation; no logical/control gain

run_length.scope: software event cost; not logical error rate

parameter_update.scope: software event actuation; not decoder or physical-memory gain

fallback.scope: synthetic syndrome-decision level; not physical memory or device

negative_result_table.scope: matched finite-cutoff two-level ten-cycle controller only

synthetic syndrome-decision level; not physical memory or device

claim_boundary.allowed: native-lane causal mechanism-off contrasts with explicit negative results, costs, and claim downgrades
claim_boundary.forbidden: one integrated-system causal ranking, universal mechanism benefit, physical-memory LER, device safety, RTL, FPGA, board, or experiment
